sentences.english: I think his name is Tom.
sentences.chinese: 我想他的名字叫汤姆。
sentences.scene: 不太确定地猜测某人的名字

sentences.english: I borrowed his bike because mine has a flat tire.
sentences.chinese: 我借了他的自行车，因为我的车胎瘪了。
sentences.scene: 向别人解释为什么骑别人的车

sentences.english: When we were kids, his house was always the one where everyone wanted to hang out because his mom made the best snacks and had a huge backyard.
sentences.chinese: 我们小时候，他家总是大家最想去玩的地方，因为他妈妈做的点心最好吃，而且后院特别大。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年时最受欢迎的玩伴家

sentences.english: My dad is really strong.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸真的很强壮。
sentences.scene: 孩子骄傲地谈论爸爸

sentences.english: You need to be strong to carry these heavy boxes upstairs.
sentences.chinese: 你得够强壮才能把这些重箱子搬上楼。
sentences.scene: 搬家时提醒朋友箱子很重

sentences.english: After the accident, she stayed strong for her family, even though she was hurting inside, and that taught me what real strength looks like.
sentences.chinese: 事故之后，她为了家人一直表现得很坚强，尽管内心很痛苦，这件事让我明白了什么是真正的坚强。
sentences.scene: 讲述某人展现出的内在力量

sentences.english: She has long brown hair.
sentences.chinese: 她有一头长长的棕色头发。
sentences.scene: 简单描述一个人的外貌

sentences.english: I'm thinking about cutting my hair short for the summer.
sentences.chinese: 我在考虑夏天把头发剪短。
sentences.scene: 和朋友讨论换发型的想法

sentences.english: Every morning, I spend way too much time trying to fix my hair because it's so curly and just seems to have a mind of its own.
sentences.chinese: 每天早上，我都要花太多时间打理头发，因为它太卷了，好像完全不听使唤。
sentences.scene: 抱怨难以打理的卷发

sentences.english: I also like pizza and pasta.
sentences.chinese: 我也喜欢披萨和意大利面。
sentences.scene: 补充说明自己的饮食喜好

sentences.english: She's a great singer and also plays the guitar really well.
sentences.chinese: 她歌唱得很好，吉他弹得也很棒。
sentences.scene: 介绍一个多才多艺的朋友

sentences.english: We went to the beach and swam all day, and we also had a barbecue at sunset, which was the perfect way to end our vacation.
sentences.chinese: 我们去了海滩游了一整天泳，还在日落时烧烤了，那真是结束假期的完美方式。
sentences.scene: 讲述假期最后一天的美好活动

sentences.english: That was very kind of you.
sentences.chinese: 你真是太善良了。
sentences.scene: 对别人的帮助表示真诚感谢

sentences.english: It was really kind of him to help me move the heavy sofa.
sentences.chinese: 他真是太好了，帮我把那个重沙发搬走了。
sentences.scene: 感激某人帮忙搬重家具

sentences.english: My neighbor is one of the kindest people I know; she always checks on the elderly folks and brings them homemade soup when they're sick.
sentences.chinese: 我邻居是我认识的最善良的人之一；她总是去看望那些老人，他们生病时还会送去自己做的汤。
sentences.scene: 描述一个乐于助人的好邻居

sentences.english: Please be quiet in the library.
sentences.chinese: 在图书馆里请保持安静。
sentences.scene: 图书馆的规则提醒

sentences.english: The baby is sleeping, so we have to be quiet.
sentences.chinese: 宝宝在睡觉，我们得小点声。
sentences.scene: 家人在婴儿房外互相提醒

sentences.english: I love going to the park early in the morning when it's still quiet and you can just hear the birds and the wind in the trees.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢一大清早去公园，那时还很安静，你能听到的只有鸟叫和风吹过树的声音。
sentences.scene: 描述清晨公园的宁静带来的享受

chinese_meaning: 最好的；最好地；最好的人或事物

sentences.english: You're the best friend ever.
sentences.chinese: 你是史上最好的朋友。
sentences.scene: 对好朋友发自内心的称赞

sentences.english: She's my best friend, and we've known each other since kindergarten.
sentences.chinese: 她是我最好的朋友，我们从幼儿园就认识了。
sentences.scene: 介绍一个相识多年的密友

sentences.english: Even though we didn't win the championship, I still gave it my best and felt proud of how far we had come as a team.
sentences.chinese: 虽然我们没赢得冠军，但我已经尽了全力，也为我们整个团队的进步感到骄傲。
sentences.scene: 比赛失利后依然肯定自己的努力

sentences.english: I read a book every night.
sentences.chinese: 我每晚都读一本书。
sentences.scene: 分享睡前的阅读习惯

sentences.english: My little sister is learning to read, and she loves picture books.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹正在学认字，她特别喜欢看图画书。
sentences.scene: 提到年幼妹妹的识字阶段

sentences.english: When I was in high school, I used to read for hours in the library, getting lost in stories and forgetting about all my homework and stress.
sentences.chinese: 高中时我常会一连几个小时在学校图书馆看书，沉浸在故事里，把所有作业和压力都忘得一干二净。
sentences.scene: 回忆在图书馆逃避压力的阅读时光

sentences.english: I like Chinese food a lot.
sentences.chinese: 我非常喜欢中国菜。
sentences.scene: 表达对中餐的喜爱

sentences.english: She's learning Chinese so she can talk to her grandparents.
sentences.chinese: 她在学中文，这样就能和爷爷奶奶聊天了。
sentences.scene: 为了与祖辈交流而学习语言

sentences.english: My grandmother tells the best stories about celebrating Chinese New Year as a child, with firecrackers, lion dances, and red envelopes full of lucky money.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶最会讲她小时候过中国新年的故事了，有鞭炮、舞狮，还有装着压岁钱的红包。
sentences.scene: 奶奶回忆童年时的春节传统

sentences.english: Let's play a game together.
sentences.chinese: 咱们一起玩个游戏吧。
sentences.scene: 邀请朋友一起玩游戏

sentences.english: He can play the guitar and the drums really well.
sentences.chinese: 他吉他弹得很好，鼓也打得很棒。
sentences.scene: 赞叹某人乐器演奏的才能

sentences.english: As a kid, I would play outside from morning until night, riding bikes, climbing trees, and making up adventures with my friends.
sentences.chinese: 小时候，我会从早到晚在外面玩，骑自行车、爬树，和朋友们一起编造各种冒险故事。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年时无拘无束的户外玩耍时光

sentences.english: This game is so much fun!
sentences.chinese: 这个游戏太好玩了！
sentences.scene: 玩游戏时的兴奋感叹

sentences.english: Our family has a game night every Friday, and it's my favorite tradition.
sentences.chinese: 我们家每周五晚上都有个游戏之夜，这是我最喜欢的家庭传统。
sentences.scene: 介绍家庭定期的娱乐活动

sentences.english: That video game was so challenging that I almost quit, but after dozens of tries, I finally beat the final level and celebrated by ordering a huge pizza.
sentences.chinese: 那个电子游戏太难了，我差点放弃，但在几十次尝试后，我终于打通了最后一关，马上订了个大披萨庆祝。
sentences.scene: 艰难通关电子游戏后的成就感

sentences.english: We play football every Saturday.
sentences.chinese: 我们每周六都打橄榄球。
sentences.scene: 谈论周末固定的运动安排

sentences.english: He's the quarterback for our school football team this year.
sentences.chinese: 他是今年我们学校橄榄球队的四分卫。
sentences.scene: 介绍校队的核心球员

sentences.english: My dad and I never miss a Sunday football game on TV; we make a ton of snacks, wear our team jerseys, and scream at the screen like we're actually at the stadium.
sentences.chinese: 我和我爸从没错过周日电视上的橄榄球赛；我们会做一大堆零食，穿上球队的球衣，对着屏幕大喊大叫，就好像真在现场一样。
sentences.scene: 父子俩在家中狂热地观看比赛

sentences.english: Do you want to play basketball later?
sentences.chinese: 你待会儿想打篮球吗？
sentences.scene: 邀约朋友一起去打球

sentences.english: I joined the basketball club at school to get better at shooting.
sentences.chinese: 我加入了学校的篮球社团，想把投篮练得更好。
sentences.scene: 为提高球技而参加社团活动

sentences.english: I remember the first time I made a three-pointer in a real basketball game; the crowd cheered, and from that moment, I was completely hooked on the sport.
sentences.chinese: 我还记得第一次在正式篮球赛中投进三分球的那一刻；全场欢呼，从那时起，我就彻底迷上了这项运动。
sentences.scene: 回忆爱上篮球的关键时刻

sentences.english: I will always love you.
sentences.chinese: 我会永远爱你。
sentences.scene: 深情的情感表达

sentences.english: My grandma always gives me a big hug when I visit her.
sentences.chinese: 我去看奶奶的时候，她总是会给我一个大大的拥抱。
sentences.scene: 描述奶奶每次见面时的固定动作

sentences.english: No matter how busy I get with work and life, I'll always find time for my family because they're the most important thing to me.
sentences.chinese: 无论工作和生活有多忙，我永远都会为家人留出时间，因为他们对我来说是最重要的。
sentences.scene: 表达家庭在心中的首要位置
